name: rosi
description: Cross-platform yt-dlp GUI built with Tauri.
author: BurntToasters <code@rosie.run>

scripts.test:rust: npm run prepare:rust-tests && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.test:cargo-safe-update: node --test scripts/cargo-safe-update.test.mjs scripts/check-cargo-update-policy.test.mjs scripts/test-all.test.js scripts/run-release.test.js scripts/github-cli.test.cjs scripts/release-branch-protection.test.cjs scripts/release-licenses.test.mjs scripts/npm-dev-audit.test.cjs scripts/generate-cargo-licenses.test.mjs scripts/check-rustsec-ignore-policy.test.mjs scripts/legacy-v4-feed.test.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src/ scripts/ e2e/ && npm run lint:comments
scripts.lint:comments: node scripts/lint-comments.mjs src src-tauri/src scripts e2e
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && node scripts/prepare-sidecars.js --allow-stub-ffmpeg && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run prepare:sidecars && tauri build -- --locked
scripts.licenses: npm run licenses:npm && npm run licenses:cargo && npm run licenses:bundled
scripts.b: git fetch origin && git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch -C beta origin/beta && git reset --hard origin/beta && git clean -fd && npm run vi
scripts.r: git fetch origin && git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch -C main origin/main && git reset --hard origin/main && git clean -fd && npm run vi && npm run gitprune:force
scripts.u: node scripts/npm-safe-update.mjs && node scripts/cargo-safe-update.mjs --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/sync-version.js && node scripts/update-metainfo.js
scripts.u2: node scripts/npm-safe-update.mjs && node scripts/cargo-safe-update.mjs --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/sync-version.js && node scripts/update-metainfo.js
scripts.build:win:prepared: npm run build:win:x64:prepared && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run build:win:x64:prepared
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run build:win:prepared
scripts.build:msstore:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run prepare:sidecars && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/tauri-windows-build.js --msstore --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.build:msstore:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run prepare:sidecars && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/tauri-windows-build.js --msstore --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.build:msstore: npm run build:msstore:x64 && npm run build:msstore:arm64
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run build:mac:universal:prepared
scripts.build:linux:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run build:linux:x64:prepared
scripts.build:linux:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && node scripts/prepare-sidecars.js --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && npm run build:linux:arm64:prepared
scripts.flatpak:bundle: node scripts/prepare-flatpak-source.js && flatpak-builder --repo=flatpak-repo --force-clean flatpak-build run.rosie.rosi.yml && flatpak build-bundle flatpak-repo dist/ROSI-Linux-x64.flatpak run.rosie.rosi
scripts.workspace:bootstrap: npm run rust:update && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run sync-version && npm run ytdlp:check && npm run ffmpeg:ensure && npm run prepare:sidecars && node scripts/update-metainfo.js
scripts.workspace:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run test:all -- --require-clean-proof
scripts.release:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run test:all -- --require-clean-proof --skip-e2e && npm run dist:clean-release-artifacts
scripts.prerelease:prepare: node scripts/release-warning.js && npm run release:preflight && npm run release:licenses
scripts.release:finalize: npm run release:mirror && git fetch origin && git reset --hard @{u} && git clean -fd
scripts.release:win:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:draft && npm run release:legacy-v4-feed && npm run rust:targets:win && npm run build:win:prepared && npm run prepare:sidecars && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:win:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:win:continue
scripts.release:mac:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:targets:mac && npm run build:mac:universal:prepared && npm run build:mac:zip && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:mac:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:mac:continue
scripts.release:mac:ssh: npm run mac:ssh:keychain && node scripts/run-release.js mac
scripts.release:mac:ssh:resume: npm run mac:ssh:keychain && npm run release:mac:resume
scripts.release:linux:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:linux:continue
scripts.release:linux:x64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:target:linux:x64 && npm run build:linux:x64:prepared && node scripts/check-linux-glibc.js --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && npm run flatpak:clean && npm run flatpak:bundle && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:linux:x64:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:linux:x64:continue
scripts.release:linux:arm64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:target:linux:arm64 && node scripts/prepare-sidecars.js --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && npm run build:linux:arm64:prepared && node scripts/check-linux-glibc.js --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:linux:arm64:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:linux:arm64:continue
scripts.setup:deb: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential curl wget file libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-dev libsoup-3.0-dev libglib2.0-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf xdg-utils xvfb 7zip flatpak flatpak-builder && sudo flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo && sudo flatpak install -y flathub org.gnome.Platform//50 org.gnome.Sdk//50 org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.node22//25.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.rust-stable//25.08
